meta.source: Sleeper API (api.sleeper.app) and unofficial projections endpoint (api.sleeper.com/projections)
notes: projected_points = per-player projected stats from Sleeper projections endpoint, rescored with this league scoring_settings
projected_pts_half_ppr = Sleeper own half-PPR projection total, for reference
projections were fetched after the fact; Sleeper may have updated them near kickoff so they may not equal the pre-game number
bench = all rostered players in the matchup minus starters (includes any IR or taxi players)
player_id null/empty starter slot means an empty lineup slot
projected_points is null when no projection exists for that player-week
